title: Modlist Companion choices file
description: Every FOMOD choice in a mod list, by name, written by Export choices file and read by Import choices file. Choices are matched to an installer by step, group and option name (never by id), so a mod update that reorders options still lines up. Fields this version does not know are ignored when importing.

format_version.description: A file with a higher version than the importing build understands is refused.

game.description: The game the list is for, as MO2 names it.

nexus_domain.description: The game's Nexus Mods address name, used to build links in the install guide.

instance_label.description: Folder name of the MO2 instance it came from.

mods.description: The newest install of each mod that was installed, in name order.

archive.description: File name (no folder) of the archive it was installed from.

skipped.description: True when the installer did not show this page, so nothing on it was chosen.

type.description: The FOMOD group rule. Informational: when replaying, the installer's own rule decides.

enabled.description: False when the FOMOD forced or blocked this option, so it was not the user's choice (default true).
